messages:
evan_neteng: Heads up — we're seeing Redis heartbeat drops in eu1 placement cluster. A handful of placement agents marked nodes unhealthy and we're seeing >20% more cold-starts for GPU jobs.

tim_oncall: How widespread? any customer errors or 5xx spikes?

evan_neteng: Errors are mostly task-queue timeouts and a small bump in 502s to the routing service. Tail latency for large-model routes (+1k tokens) jumped ~300ms. Logs: 
```
ERROR placement: heartbeat timeout host=10.2.4.18 last_seen=38s
WARN routing: fallback to cold-start hostpool eu1-size-gpu-2
```

alice_infra: I'm starting a rolling restart of the placement agents in eu1 to clear stale locks. Will do 2 hosts at a time, 30s drain.

maria_ops: Heads up for customer comms — we should propose a fallback/traffic-shift to eu2 for high-throughput customers. Accepting increased cross-region egress cost.

support_jen: Draft status page blurb: "Investigating increased latency and intermittent errors in eu1. We're performing targeted restarts and traffic shifts; some customers may see cross-region routing to eu2. ETA for mitigation: 30–45 minutes." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

evan_neteng: Agree on ETA. Restarting placement agents now. If heartbeat flaps continue after restarts, we'll flip placement routing policy to prefer eu2 for heavy-load flows.

ops-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-4873. Priority: P2. Assigned: evan_neteng, alice_infra, tim_oncall.

tim_oncall: Rolling restart started at 1870012400. Monitoring CPU, RX/TX on placement hosts.

alice_infra: 2 hosts restarted. heartbeats returned for those. Still seeing 3 hosts with >20s jitter. Taking them out of rotation for deeper inspection.

maria_ops: Preparing customer email for impacted accounts (top 25 by spend). Copy for review: 
"We are investigating elevated latency in our eu1 region affecting inference start times. We are rolling restarts and routing some traffic to eu2 to restore performance. We expect mitigation within 45 minutes. Please reply if you need a dedicated region pin."

support_jen: LGTM. Add note about possible temporary higher egress charges for cross-region routing.

evan_neteng: Quick diagnostic: appears to correlate with Redis replica promotion flaps after failover events. Suspect a flaky network path between primary and replicas during small maintenance on infra switch. Eng-infra needs to confirm.

statusbot: Status page updated (partial outage): "Investigating - eu1 placement & routing: increased latency and intermittent errors. Mitigation in progress."

alice_infra: We're at 1870012465 — all placement hosts replaced or drained; routing fallback to eu2 enabled for high-concurrency routes. Early metrics show tail latency returning to normal for most customers.

maria_ops: I'll send the customer email and update CSMs. Re cost: we'll absorb cross-region egress for the next 24h and then reevaluate if they were routed long-term.

tim_oncall: Marking incident as active-monitoring. If no regressions in 30m, we'll de-escalate.

evan_neteng: Follow-ups: (1) postmortem to include root cause: redis replication/networking; (2) add a placement-agent health-check that avoids mass-marking on transient heartbeat jitter; (3) run a short chaos test in staging for redis primaries.

support_jen: Thanks team. I'll post final status update after the 30m quiet window. :thumbsup:
